canonical_project: Phoenix Group Bole Lemi data mining facility (hydropower-backed)
notes: Phoenix Group signed an 80 MW PPA in Ethiopia (Reuters, Jan 2025), added 52 MW (Apr 2025) and launched a 30 MW hydropower-backed mining/compute facility at Bole Lemi Industrial Park, Addis Ababa with EEP (Nov 2025; 6,250 sqm purpose-built site). Operator+site+MW named by reputable press = B; EEP primary record would upgrade to A.
